frontmatter.name: langgraph-fundamentals
frontmatter.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when writing ANY LangGraph code. Covers StateGraph, state schemas, nodes, edges, Command, Send, invoke, streaming, and error handling.

frontmatter.name: deep-code-review
frontmatter.description: Performs deep code review with a mandatory AskQuestion step when scope is unclear (full codebase or named area vs diff or change set only); emphasizes security vulnerabilities, unsafe data handling, authz gaps, and unintended changes. Use when the user requests code review, security review, PR review, diff audit, pre-merge check, vulnerability pass, or asks what a change broke.

frontmatter.name: aws-manager-code-segmentation
frontmatter.description: Defines how AWS Manager application code is segmented by feature module (Secrets, Audit, IAM, Settings, etc.) across UI routes, API handlers, lib/aws, components, and agent tools. Use when adding features, reorganizing code, wiring navigation, or extending lib/modules/registry.ts.

frontmatter.name: dashboard-design
frontmatter.description: Design B2B and SaaS dashboards using Excited-agency methodology — decision-first layout, role-based information hierarchy, research before pixels, and measurable UX. Use when building, redesigning, or reviewing dashboards, KPI screens, admin panels, CRM/ERP overviews, analytics views, or data-heavy product UI.

frontmatter.name: langchain-fundamentals
frontmatter.description: Create LangChain agents with create_agent, define tools, and use middleware for human-in-the-loop and error handling.
